---
name: 📜 RFC Proposal
about: Propose a framework evolution (new artifact, AI service, principle, etc.)
title: '[RFC] '
labels: 'rfc-proposal, needs-discussion'
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A single sentence describing what you propose.

## Problem

What real problem does this proposal solve? Do you have concrete examples where teams have had this problem?

## Proposal

What you would change, exactly. Be specific: new file, modify existing, new principle, new AI service, etc.

## Use case

A concrete end-to-end case. Without an example, the proposal isn't evaluable.

## Alternatives considered

What you evaluated before arriving at this proposal. Why you discarded them.

## Failure mode

When does your proposal not work or cause harm? Be honest: a proposal without a declared failure mode is a red flag.

## Adoption cost

What do teams that already adopted ORDITO need to do to integrate this proposal?

## Impact on manifesto principles

Which of the 10 principles are affected? How?

## Proposed status

- [ ] Draft (in writing)
- [ ] Ready for discussion (open community discussion)
- [ ] Preparing implementation PR
